credits.title: Lost in the Snow Wave
credits.author: hatmix
credits.note: Original Ogg audio distributed without changes; looping background music. Voluntary author credit retained.

credits.title: Deep Star Maps 2020
credits.author: Ernie Wright · NASA/GSFC Scientific Visualization Studio · ESA/Gaia/DPAC
credits.note: 4k star and Milky Way maps tone-mapped from NASA HDR sources. Rendering is not endorsed by NASA. Optional 8k Milky Way retains the same base exposure and tone map as the 4k image; photographic grading is applied at runtime.

credits.title: CGI Moon Kit
credits.author: NASA/GSFC/SVS · NASA/GSFC/ASU · NASA/GSFC/MIT · Ernie Wright
credits.note: LROC 2025 colour map and LOLA visual elevation map; compact browser textures.

credits.title: Solar System Scope textures
credits.author: INOVE
credits.note: Downsampled and compressed from source maps. Source colours are enhanced; some unmapped planetary regions are artistic completions.

credits.title: d3-celestial star and constellation catalogues
credits.author: Olaf Frohn · Hipparcos · Yale Bright Star Catalog · IAU
credits.note: 5044 real magnitude-six stars at J2000 and 36367 additional real stars with 6 < mag <= 8; 88 constellation IDs. GeoJSON fields compacted, right ascension wrapped to 0–360 degrees, Serpens groups merged. Existing bright-star metadata and picking remain separate.

credits.title: Three.js
credits.author: Three.js authors
credits.note: Browser rendering and EXR source preparation. Device-to-camera orientation basis adapted from Three.js r133 DeviceOrientationControls, under MIT; original authorship retained.

credits.title: Precomputed Atmospheric Scattering
credits.author: Shota Matsuda / Takram · Eric Bruneton · INRIA
credits.note: Takram three-atmosphere 0.19.1. Unmodified Earth atmosphere lookup textures. Full upstream component notices retained. Assets originate from the pinned npm release; upstream license text is separately pinned in the manifest documentation.

credits.title: Postprocessing
credits.author: Raoul van Rüschen
credits.note: Version 6.39.5; bloom, antialiasing and tone mapping.

credits.title: Three Geospatial
credits.author: Shota Matsuda / Takram
credits.note: Version 0.9.1; atmospheric rendering coordinate utilities. Full package notice retained, including the separate Apache-2.0 notice for its additional WebGPU source path.
